document.abstract: The adoption of the ATSC's Digital Television Standard means that pictures may be broadcast in a number of different formats rather than the 525/601 system used for analog NTSC. Many television stations have already declared their proposed formats for standard definition (SD) and high definition (HD), and it is clear that several will soon be in use. This paper establishes aims for such a scheme, examines possible ways of working with multiple input and output formats in post-production, and formulates a practical structure for such equipment. It also looks at the possible impact this may have on operational practices.
